articles.title: Ten Years of Prohibition: Did Addiction Leave, or Just Change Its Route?
articles.author: Divyanshu
articles.summary:
A Question from the Streets of Patna
Bihar's liquor ban has completed ten years, but the law is as weak on the ground as it is strict on paper. This question did not come from a report. It came from the streets of Patna.

articles.title: The Marble Speaks, Humans Remain Silent.
articles.author: Divyanshu
articles.summary: Whether the Taj Mahal is a symbol of love or not, a far bigger question is: when we look at it, whom do we remember, and whom do we forget?
